summary: Frontend-only testing for Marino Empire Hamster-Kombat-tier features. Verified all 9 new flows: intro skip → home loads with mascot/balance/league/energy, Daily Combo, Daily Cipher, Boost Center, Airdrop, TR/EN language toggle, tap combo counter with particles, 5x Tap Boost visual badge, bottom-nav tab switching, settings/profile sheets. ALL critical flows pass. No JS errors observed.

tests_performed.intro_and_home_load: PASS - 'VİDEOYU ATLA' skip works, home shows character, balance 10,267,807, ALTIN LİGİ badge, energy 880/890, 5-tab nav (Tıkla/Binalar/Görevler/Casino/Dostlar). All 8 critical data-testids present.
tests_performed.daily_combo: PASS - sheet opens with 3 empty slots, 12-card grid (Ace♣♥♦♠/King/Queen/Jack/Joker/Chip/Dice/Wheel/Slot), '6/6' attempts, live countdown timer ⏳ 07:32:36. Confirm button properly disabled until 3 cards selected. Wrong combo → toast '❌ Yanlış kombo, tekrar dene (5/6)' + attempts decrement to 5/6 + slot shake animation. Sheet closes via X.
tests_performed.daily_cipher: PASS - sheet opens with morse-display (9 dots + 8 dashes spans for 7-letter word), 7 letter boxes, 26-key A-Z keyboard, SİL/ÇÖZ buttons. Typing A,B,C fills boxes 'A|B|C||||'. SİL removes last letter → 'A|B|||||'. Wrong submit → toast '❌ Yanlış cevap, tekrar dene'. Sheet closes via X.
tests_performed.boost_center: PASS - 5 boost cards present: Tam Enerji (3/3 free), Tap Boost (3/3 free), Çoklu Tıklama (1,000 coin), Enerji Limiti (1,000 coin), Otomatik Tıklama (5,000 coin / 12h). Activating Tap Boost shows '⚡ 5x Tap Boost! 20s' toast + visible '5x' badge near tap button. Sheet closes via X.
tests_performed.airdrop: PASS - sheet opens with $MARINO AIRDROP title, hero coin image, 6 checklist items, CÜZDAN BAĞLA → ✅ Cüzdan Bağlı after click. Sheet closes via X.
tests_performed.language_toggle: PASS - TR active by default. Click EN: KASAYI TOPLA → COLLECT VAULT, role İmparator → Emperor, all data-i18n labels update. Click TR reverts. Selection persisted via localStorage 'm_lang' (verified by reload — collect button stayed in TR/EN as last set).
tests_performed.tap_combo_counter: PASS - 12 rapid clicks (<600ms apart) on #btnTap triggered '.combo-pop' with text '10x COMBO! 🔥' (visible). 20 coin particle elements spawned during clicks. Balance incremented from 10,267,807 → 10,268,887.
tests_performed.bottom_nav_switching: PASS - All 5 tabs switch correctly: data-tab='home'→view-home, 'buildings'→view-buildings, 'tasks'→view-tasks, 'store'→view-store, 'friends'→view-friends. Active class applied to clicked nav.
tests_performed.settings_profile_sheets: PASS - settings-btn opens #sheetSettings (closes via X). profile-area opens #sheetProfile (closes via X). All sheets use .sheet-close with data-close attribute working.
tests_performed.no_js_errors: PASS - No pageerror or console.error events captured across all flows.

critical_code_review_comments: index.html is ~3,931 lines (CSS + HTML + JS in one file). For maintainability, recommend splitting JS (HK module ~500 lines around 3450+) into a separate /app/public/js/hk.js module. Not blocking, but >700 line policy violated.

Tap-boost visual badge reuses class 'autotap-badge' for the 5x Tap Boost indicator — slightly misleading naming (autotap suggests Otomatik Tıklama). Consider renaming to 'tap-boost-badge' for clarity.
localStorage-only persistence for Daily Combo/Cipher/Boost is fine per spec (mocked), but users can wipe via DevTools to reset attempts. Acceptable for MVP per request.

Combo close handler reattaches via document.querySelectorAll('.sheet-close').forEach(b => b.onclick = ...) at init only — works because sheet DOM nodes persist; verified close works on all new sheets (Combo/Cipher/Boost/Airdrop).
test_credentials: ?testmode=1 query param bypasses Telegram auth (per agent_to_agent_context_note). No login required.
seed_data_creation: None - all new features use localStorage, no remote seeding needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All HK-tier features (combo/cipher/boost/airdrop/lang/combo-counter/particles/5x badge) are fully functional client-side. If retesting after changes: use https://0ddecbb6-5154-4117-b6ef-333203c25d17.preview.emergentagent.com/?testmode=1, skip intro with text='VİDEOYU ATLA'. Correct DOM IDs: #comboOptions (cards) not #comboCards, #cipherBoxes not #cipherWord, #cipherKeys not #cipherKeyboard, #morseDisplay (renders <span class='morse-dot/dash'/> not text), #btnCipherBack (SİL). Use page.mouse.click() on bounding-box center for #btnTap to reliably trigger combo popup (10x every 10 rapid taps within 600ms window). Existing Supabase-backed flows (binalar/görevler/casino/dostlar) may show 'Veritabanı Hatası' in testmode for some remote calls — that is PRE-EXISTING and not a regression per problem statement.
